localModifications: model_catalog.py advertises Mia context budgets of 250000 tokens for the offered 1M-capable models while retaining native route IDs
model_catalog.py lists claude-opus-5-5 so the account picker's Opus 5.5 route is not filtered out
model_catalog.py lists claude-sonnet-5-5 in place of claude-sonnet-5 (the sonnet alias and saved claude-sonnet-5 choices resolve to it), and __init__.py uses it as the default auxiliary model
model_catalog.py offers Haiku 5.5 through its plain native route (1M context by default in Claude Code 2.1.293+); retired Haiku 4.5 and Opus 5/4.8 aliases resolve to their 5.5 successors

directsdk_setup.py preserves successful empty discovery, __init__.py preserves that result and removes curated fallback_models so account-only retired rows cannot advertise unreported successor models
directsdk_setup.py and plugin.yaml default the claude_code_telemetry setting to off, keeping Claude Code quiet as Mia always has
model_catalog.py omits Mythos 5.1, which Mia does not offer

directsdk.py sends an empty activity chunk at most once a second while a content block is open and the API is sending pings or deltas, and __init__.py declares streams_chunks so Hermes uses its streaming path (scripts/hermes-external-process-streaming.patch), which times silence rather than the whole call
